finding.comment: the job slot is cleared only once the worker is known to exist, so the unknown-worker path leaves the job intact; the drop concern does not apply

--- a/worker/pool.py
+++ b/worker/pool.py

     def dispatch(self, name):
+        worker = self.workers.get(name)
+        if worker is None:
+            return
+        self.job = None
+        self.submit(worker)
